GRAYS HARBOR COUNTY SHERIFF'S OFFICE · FISCAL YEAR 2026
2026 Budget Transparency Report

This report provides a public accounting of how Grays Harbor County Sheriff's Office tax dollars are budgeted and
spent. The following pages contain a budget snapshot for each of the four main General Fund cost centers
supporting Sheriff's Office operations — providing the financial foundation for law enforcement, corrections,
emergency preparedness, and court security services for the residents of Grays Harbor County.

BUDGET AUTHORITY & OVERSIGHT
As an elected official, Sheriff Darrin Wallace is responsible for the fiscal management of all funds appropriated to the
Sheriff's Office under RCW 36.28 (Sheriff — Powers and Duties), RCW 36.32.120 (County Auditor — Duties), and
RCW 36.40 (County Budget Law). These statutes require the Sheriff to operate within appropriated budgets, maintain
accurate financial records, and report expenditures to the Board of County Commissioners.
The Grays Harbor County Board of County Commissioners adopts the annual budget and approves all amendments
under RCW 36.40.071. The three budget pools — Salaries & Benefits, Capital, and Operating/Other — are tracked
separately; savings in one pool cannot be applied to another without formal Commissioner approval.
